ns2:section.sectionText: Exploration of German-language literature, history, and culture from the eighteenth to the twentieth century. We will investigate tales of mystery and stories of mistaken identity by major German, Austrian and Swiss writers and see how they relate to the larger social, economic and political context. Although the focus is on literature, the course has an interdisciplinary component--we will consider questions pertinent to philosophy and to the other arts.
